title: Drop by superseding; links are a maintained graph
quote: I don't understand withdraw. Don't forget the reflection and superseding step. We already have a basic graph, wiki links, between all our entries, and gbrain has great concepts for it. brain also maintains and audits the links, right?
means: There is no withdraw verb: a doc stops holding only when a newer doc supersedes it through the reflection. The links between entries are brain's graph: typed, audited by the check and maintained by a separate pass, learning from gbrain.

reflection.checked: every decision before D-48 that held
